name: kormo-hr
description: Kormo HR — multi-tenant Human Resource Management Suite (employee lifecycle: onboarding to clearance)

scripts.bootstrap: npm install && npm run build -w @kormo/shared && npm run infra:up && node scripts/wait-for-db.mjs && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kormo/shared && npm run build -w @kormo/api && npm run build -w @kormo/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @kormo/api" "npm run dev -w @kormo/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @kormo/api" "npm run start -w @kormo/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kormo/shared && npm run test -w @kormo/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kormo/api && npm run typecheck -w @kormo/web
scripts.verify: npm run test -w @kormo/shared && npm run verify:api && npm run verify:workflow
